test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

It's so stressful to think that what you have build with hard work is at risk.

options.text: think that what you have build
with hard work is at risk.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**build**".
 
• The correct past participle form of "build" is "**built**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**think that what you have built**," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It's so stressful to think that what you have **built **__with hard work is at risk."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
 
• **Option 3: It's so stressful to** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: with hard work is at risk.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
